description: av1gpu's side of the L4 compression results, re-encoded with the 4x4-tile default (perf/tiles-4x4: turbo, turbo2 and turbo3 use 4x4 tiles for images of 2 MP and more, instead of 2x2 / 4x2) and re-scored on an AWS g6.4xlarge (NVIDIA L4), with v0.3.0 (2x2) encoded alongside for the byte checks. The CPU baselines (libaom, SVT-AV1, WebP, NVENC) are the stored ones in bench/results/; below 2 MP the files are byte-identical to v0.3.0's, so those rows equal the published ones.
